name: Elena Rostova
bio: Elena has transformed over 6,500 pairs of brows over the past decade. Trained in Vienna, Munich, and Beverly Hills, she pioneered the Featherstroke 3D mapping method that harmonizes brow arching with individual cranial symmetry.
quote: Eyebrows are sisters, not twins — but in our studio, they are royalty.

name: Sofia Vance
certifications: Swiss Color International Lip Master Certified
bio: Sofia is internationally renowned for her velvety, natural lip blush results that look like effortless hydrated tinted lip balm. She specializes in corrective color neutralizing for cool and dark melanin lip tones.
quote: Lip blush should never look like tattoo ink; it should look like youthful health restored.

name: Maya Lin
bio: Maya specializes in zero-trauma digital nano machine hairstrokes, catering specifically to clients with oily, sensitive, or mature skin that cannot tolerate standard blading.
quote: Precision down to the tenth of a millimeter is where true elegance lives.

name: Camilla Rossi
certifications: Tina Davies I Love Ink Pro Certified
bio: With an eye for delicate, understated luxury, Camilla creates bespoke brow arches that highlight facial bone structure, opening up the eyes and taking years off her clients' appearance.
quote: Confidence is the prettiest thing you can wear — great brows are just the frame.
